title: 中美科技竞争：战场已到CEO办公室，黄仁勋该担国安责任吗？
speaker: Ellie Rostom

segments.en: This that we know that are targeted not so much the CEO of a tech company as big as as a video. I'm just wondering do you see that as a bit of a step change for China. Not really. I think the the bigger story there is really so one of the things I do is map supply chains and so usually I'm looking for the inside of a threat within a supply chain in the incorporation structure of the firm.
segments.zh: 我们知道，被针对的并非像视频中那样大型科技公司的CEO。我想问，你是否认为这对中国来说是一个转折点？不完全是。我认为更大的故事在于，我的一项工作是绘制供应链图谱，因此我通常关注供应链内部以及公司股权结构中的威胁。

segments.en: Invest the private equity that's investing the suppliers the distributors we don't usually look at it in terms of the extra and there till a fair that the CEO is having so you know that is really hits very close to home.
segments.zh: 私募股权**的供应商、分销商，我们通常不会从CEO的角度来看待，所以这确实非常贴近个人。

segments.en: I think the the one of the key what this story is really shining a light on is for the first time this competition this competition between the China and the United States.
segments.zh: 我认为这个故事真正揭示的关键点之一是，中美之间的竞争首次如此凸显。

segments.en: This tech competition is really happening at the level of private companies and so which are headed by CEO's these are not members of the US government.
segments.zh: 这场科技竞争实际上发生在私营公司层面，这些公司由CEO领导，他们不是美国政府成员。

segments.en: They don't have necessarily they're not legally obligated to protect the US national security in in in in the way that a former intelligence officer has and so but yet they are so incredibly important.
segments.zh: 他们不一定有法律义务像前情报官员那样保护美国国家安全，但他们却极其重要。

segments.en: Especially somebody like Jensen who is heading you know if not the most important one of the most important companies in the world and so the question is that there is a different burden that falls on him.
segments.zh: 尤其是像黄仁勋这样的人，他领导着世界上最重要的公司之一，因此问题在于他肩负着不同的责任。

segments.en: And this seems quite frankly quite careless and again like with all the respect to his family this is also a family tragedy.
segments.zh: 坦率地说，这似乎相当粗心，而且再次尊重他的家人，这也是一个家庭悲剧。

segments.en: How would you see you know when it comes to spy between US and China what would you say this is probably the most intense period we've seen since maybe the cold war me how how serious is it now between the two.
segments.zh: 在中美间谍活动方面，你认为这可能是自冷战以来最激烈的时期吗？现在两国之间有多严重？
